description: Upgrade Python from 3.13 to 3.14 across the project. Update version references, Dockerfile base image, tool configs, and remove configs that are now inferred automatically from requires-python.
steps: Update `.python-version` at repo root from `3.13` to `3.14`
Update `agent/pyproject.toml` [tool.black]: remove `target-version = ["py313"]` entirely (Black 26.5.1 infers from requires-python automatically)
Update `agent/pyproject.toml` [tool.ruff]: remove `target-version = "py313"` entirely (Ruff infers from requires-python in the same pyproject.toml when target-version is not set)
Update `agent/Dockerfile`: change base image from `python:3.13-slim` to `python:3.14-slim`
Update `CONTRIBUTING.md`: change prerequisite reference from `Python 3.13` to `Python 3.14`
Run `cd agent && uv lock` to regenerate the lock file for the new Python version requirement
Run the full quality check suite: pytest, mypy, ruff, black
acceptance_criteria: No `target-version` in [tool.black] section (removed, inferred from requires-python)
No `target-version` in [tool.ruff] section (removed, inferred from requires-python)
mypy, ruff, and black checks pass
verification: cd agent && uv run mypy src/
cd agent && uv run ruff check .
